q_and_a.question: Kya DentPrep ek student ko UPSC Dental Surgeon ke liye poori taiyari kara sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Target: ek structured primary preparation platform, lekin abhi content incomplete hai. Exam success guaranteed nahi; content coverage, clinical review, practice retention, aur real candidate QA ke baad hi exam-ready kehna hai.

q_and_a.question: Kya sirf app par depend karna safe hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: DentPrep mein verified notes, MCQs, cases, interview practice aur official links hone chahiye. Student ko authoritative textbooks, official notices aur qualified clinical teaching ke saath cross-check ka option hamesha mile.

q_and_a.question: Kya app UPSC ka official partner hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Har relevant screen par independent educational tool ka disclaimer dikhe. UPSC logo/endorsement, authorized question bank, official exam scores ya selection guarantee imply na kare.

q_and_a.question: Exam ki date announce nahi hui toh study kaise chalegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Exam-date-unknown mode hamesha available rahe. Syllabus mastery aur revision indefinite chalte rahein; official date verified hone par hi countdown aur priority reshuffle ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya exam pattern, marking ya cutoff app bana sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Official advertisement aur latest corrigenda mein jo documented ho wahi display ho. Unannounced written RT scheme, marking, weightage ya interview rubric ko Unknown/Unconfirmed mark karo.

q_and_a.question: Padhai ka target BDS syllabus hai ya sirf UPSC notification?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Core learning 15 BDS groups aur clinically relevant public-service skills ko cover kare; official recruitment requirements ek separate verified layer hon. Dono ko milakar invented UPSC syllabus na banao. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: Kya har learner ke liye ek hi roadmap rahega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Starting baseline, existing knowledge, daily hours, practice errors aur retention results ke hisaab se adaptive path ho. User chahe toh manual adjustments bhi kar sake.

q_and_a.question: Kya har student ki progress alag save hogi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Haan, own account ke liye RLS-protected progress, answers, plans, bookmarks, interview transcripts. Logout/account switch par private cache clear ho aur cross-user data leakage test ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya design images mein jo accuracy 86.4% hai wo real hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Woh illustration sample hai. Production par authenticated learner ke actual submitted answers aur defined denominator se calculated result hi dikhe; no attempts par blank/Not yet measured.

q_and_a.question: Kya purani chats ka kaam phir se banega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Work ko GitHub latest main, Cloudflare deployment receipt, Lovable database, 72-slide blueprint aur current issue ledger se deduplicate karna hai. Earlier chat claims ko verified status se cross-check kare.

q_and_a.question: Kaise confirm hoga ki saare essential topics cover hue?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Blueprint ke 15 subject groups se subject->unit->topic->learning outcome coverage matrix banao. Har essential outcome ko reviewed lesson, retrieval question, case ya oral prompt se map karo; missing cells gap report mein dikhao.

q_and_a.question: Kaun decide karega kaunsa topic essential hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: DCI/National Dental Commission ke relevant BDS regulations, authorized textbooks, verified recruitment notices aur qualified dental faculty editorial review. Exam-weightage guess ko evidence na mano.

q_and_a.question: Kya outdated medical information student ko sikh sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Har clinical item ke source version, review date aur next-review due date record ho. Guideline change par flagged content temporarily pause ho aur approved correction ke baad publish ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya AI khud clinical notes likh kar turant publish karega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. AI drafts create kar sakta hai, par clinical publication ke liye medical author + independent qualified reviewer + evidence sign-off + audit trail mandatory hai.

q_and_a.question: Kya primary sources aur textbooks ke citations honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Haan. Each claim/lesson ke source title, edition/year, stable URL/identifier, relevant section, reviewed_on aur reviewer fields. Unsupported assertions ko source-needed status mile.

q_and_a.question: Agar 2 trusted references disagree karein toh kya hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Disputed status set karo, uncertainty explain karo, reviewer consensus record karo, aur ambiguous clinical MCQ ko publish na karo jab tak defensible single-best-answer aur scope clear na ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya syllabus me 15 subjects ki equal importance hogi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Coverage sabki hogi, lekin time allocation evidence-based baseline mastery, clinical importance aur official constraints se ho; invented exam weightage ke basis par false equal/unequal marks na dikhao. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: Kya diagrams/images scientifically sahi hongi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Illustrations ke anatomical labels, orientation aur claims dental expert verify kare; alt text + usage rights record hon. Generated artwork ko illustration label aur source-approved clinical anatomy ke saath QA karo.

q_and_a.question: Kya Hindi-medium ya weak-English student bhi samajh payega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: English exam-ready explanations with plain-English glossary, expandable Hindi/Hinglish help where feasible, progressively harder vocabulary and comprehension checks. Translation clinically reviewed ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya app medicine prescribe karna sikha degi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: App educational clinical reasoning sikhaye, patient-specific advice ya unsupervised treatment instructions nahi. Safety-sensitive drug doses/interventions ko expert approval, context aur supervision caveats ke bina surface na karo.

q_and_a.question: Ek lesson ke end par kya student ko sach me samajh aaya ye check hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Har lesson objective-based retrieval questions, 1-minute summary, applied mini-case aur confidence rating se check ho; sirf page open/read time ko mastery na samjho.

q_and_a.question: Kya videos compulsory honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Text, diagrams, guided examples, optional video/audio sab accessible modes ho sakte hain. Learning outcome test zaroori hai; video watch completion alone mastery ka proxy nahi.

q_and_a.question: Kya basic se advanced order automatic hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Prerequisite graph mein anatomy/physiology foundations se clinical application link karo. Baseline strong ho toh learner skip test de sakta hai; weak ho toh foundation remediation mile.

q_and_a.question: Student ko galat concept samajh aaye toh?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Incorrect answer ke liye why-wrong explanation, misconception tag, concept recap aur new transfer question do. Sirf correct answer flash karke learning complete na mark karo.

q_and_a.question: Har topic kitni baar revise hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Adaptive spaced-review scheduling retrieval performance, difficulty aur forgetting patterns par based ho. Daily fixed count guarantee nahi; overdue items and estimated workload transparent rakho.

q_and_a.question: Kya 7 din baad bhi yaad hai test hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: delayed retrieval checkpoints (e.g. next day, one week, one month) as configured, without exposing answers. Retention measure item-level first-attempt accuracy and transfer performance.

q_and_a.question: Kya student ko baar-baar same question milne se fake accuracy aayegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Repeated-item accuracy separate dikhao, unseen question accuracy alag; spaced old questions and fresh transfer questions ka balance rakho. Suspicious exact repetition se inflated mastery avoid karo.

q_and_a.question: Kya progress ka graph bas decoration hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Date, actual submissions, attempted/correct counts, mastery tags, revisions and coverage evidence backed chart ho; zero data par honest empty state. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: Kya dyslexia/low-vision ya screen-reader students padh sakte hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: WCAG 2.2 AA target, keyboard navigation, headings/labels, contrast, large text, reduced motion, readable tables, caption/alt text aur screen reader semantic announcements test karo.

q_and_a.question: Kya daily teacher jaisa guidance milega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Dashboard par Today next-best-action: continue lesson, review due, weak-topic drill, interview practice. Reason visible ho: e.g. last two unseen questions wrong, so repeat underlying concept.

q_and_a.question: MCQs ke sahi answers kaun verify karega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Author drafts with single-best-answer rationale; at least one independent dental reviewer verifies stem, all options, answer, distractors, sources and clinical relevance before publish.

q_and_a.question: Kya PYQs original UPSC questions honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Only if independently verifiable and legally usable with paper/year/source; otherwise label original DentPrep practice items. Never invent UPSC previous-year provenance.

q_and_a.question: Kya MCQ mein 2 options sahi ho sakte hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Ambiguity gate reject kare. Context-sensitive clinical items clarify assumptions, jurisdiction and wording; unresolved ambiguity -> withdraw/review, not force arbitrary correct choice.

q_and_a.question: Kya option reveal test se pehle ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Exam simulation mode me never; practice mode me answer save hone ke baad explanation optional. Browser/network replay se correctness prematurely leak na ho.

q_and_a.question: Kya random questions difficulty balanced rahenge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Question blueprint by subject/topic/difficulty and review status; deterministic seeded test builds when needed. No published questions -> explicit empty state, never fill with draft content.

q_and_a.question: Kya 10, 20, 30, 50 questions user choose kar sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Configurable count with actual available approved pool; requested count > pool then show truthful actual count or disable start. No duplicated questions to match advertised quota.

q_and_a.question: Timer khatam hone par kya hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Server-authoritative attempt start/time limit, expiration handling, submission idempotency and clear final status; background tab/clock tampering should not produce silent score corruption.

q_and_a.question: Skip, Previous, Next se answers lose honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Explicit saved/unsaved indicators; selected but unsaved state warning; navigation preserves saved state, retries idempotently. Test refresh, back, offline, connection drop.

q_and_a.question: Score ka formula kya rahega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Define raw correct, attempted, skipped and total separately. Accuracy = correct/attempted for attempted-only metric; score may be correct/total under DentPrep one-point scheme. Any official negative-marking is applied only if sourced. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: Wrong answer copy aur revise kaise hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Wrong question auto enters private revision queue with topic and reason, links to reviewed lesson; revision repeats and tracks correction over time without rewriting historical original score.

q_and_a.question: Accuracy percent 90 hone se mastery confirm ho jayegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Confidence requires unseen questions, topic coverage, delayed retention, difficulty and sample size. Show accuracy with count and uncertainty; 9/10 is not same evidence as 90/100.

q_and_a.question: Kya har subject ki accuracy alag dikhegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Haan, subject and topic breakdown based on own attempts, filtering reviewed unique items and showing sample counts. Insufficient data -> Not enough evidence.

q_and_a.question: Kya wrong-answer details private rahenge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Haan. Per-user access control, encrypted transport, limited retention, export/delete controls as implemented and a test that user A never sees B transcripts/results.

q_and_a.question: Kya student khud confidence 100% mark kare toh app believe karegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Self-reported confidence separately track ho; mastery retrieval outcomes se validate ho. Confidence calibration gap highlight karo when high confidence and repeated errors coincide.

q_and_a.question: Kya lesson read time ko progress maan sakte hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Engagement alag; mastery nahi. Video watched/read complete only completion indicator; concept mastery check after low-hint practice and delayed re-test.

q_and_a.question: Kya accuracy tests mein cheat/answer memorization detect hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Do not accuse users; recognize repeated identical items, unexpectedly fast responses and open-note modes. Separate practice accuracy from timed/unseen accuracy and label limitations.

q_and_a.question: Kya AI explanations ko automatically correct samjha jayega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. AI output is a candidate draft; grounded response with references and clinical safety boundaries. In conflict, prefer approved content and route uncertain answers to human review.

q_and_a.question: Kaise pata chalega student exam-ready hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No deterministic pass predictor. Dashboard can show readiness indicators: breadth, unseen performance, retention, clinical reasoning, mock consistency; attach confidence/limitations and no UPSC selection probability.

q_and_a.question: Kya learning analytics algorithms test honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: formula unit tests, seed data, no-attempt states, time-zone IST, denominator edge cases, duplicate answers, revision invalidation and longitudinal regression tests.

q_and_a.question: Kya student feedback se poor question ko flag kar sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: report a suspected error with item version, optional note, reviewer queue and resolution transparency. Valid disputes trigger regrading when fair and documented. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: 7-day aur 30-day plan ka matlab padhai bas itne din hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Ye renewable planning cycles hain; exam-date-unknown mode mein cycles indefinitely continue. Next cycle previous work and overdue tasks ko carry forward kare.

q_and_a.question: Kya long-term syllabus roadmap dikhna chahiye?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: foundation to clinical application to revision and interview, with coverage percent and projected workload—not a fabricated official deadline.

q_and_a.question: Agar student 30 minute roz deta hai vs 4 hours?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Plan workload available study time, fatigue and current mastery ke hisaab se scale ho; unrealistic daily goals avoid karo and manual adjust allowed ho.

q_and_a.question: Agar 10 din gap ho jaaye toh?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No guilt/pop-up spam: missed tasks reschedule, prioritize due revisions, offer short restart plan; historical record remains unchanged.

q_and_a.question: Kya exam date announce hone par automatic mode change hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Only after official verified notification and ideally user confirmation; preserve existing progress and compute remaining days, prioritizing high-yield weak concepts without invented marking scheme.

q_and_a.question: Kya interview practice shuru se chalegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: clinical, English communication and public-service scenarios weekly parallel; exact intensity varies per baseline and future official selection stage.

q_and_a.question: Kya plan automatic renew ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: When cycle ends, create reviewed next cycle automatically or with user acceptance per settings. Never silently duplicate tasks or reset completed topics.

q_and_a.question: Kya topic priority dynamic hogi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: unmet prerequisites, missed retention, risk-significant clinical topics, user goals and officially known constraints; provide explainable reason for recommendation.

q_and_a.question: Kya late-night padhne par streak galat ho sakti hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Use user timezone or IST preference consistently; define study-day boundary; never count mere login as meaningful study without disclosed criteria.

q_and_a.question: Kya data export ki suvidha hogi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: User may export plans, progress and question history where privacy-safe and allowed. Support deletion and explain what permanently persists, with no loss from ordinary app upgrades.

q_and_a.question: Clinical case mein wrong treatment choose karne par kya hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Educational corrective feedback should flag safety issue, red flags and appropriate escalation. Never encourage patient-specific unsupervised treatment.

q_and_a.question: Emergency signs ko priority kaise milegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Red-flag-first decision tree verified by expert: airway compromise, major bleeding, sepsis concerns and urgent referral need identified in context, with no overconfident one-size-fits-all dosing.

q_and_a.question: Kya cases actual patients ke records honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Use synthetic or de-identified cases with valid authorization and privacy protections. No identifiable patient stories in public fixtures or prompts.

q_and_a.question: Kya clinical diagrams generated images se ban sakti hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Possible if labelled as educational illustrations, but actual anatomy/diagnosis claims need independent specialist verification and permission/right-to-use review.

q_and_a.question: Kya differential diagnosis sikhaya jayega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: ask evidence for/against each candidate diagnosis, needed investigations and uncertainty; avoid teaching mechanical guess as clinical certainty.

q_and_a.question: Kya emergency clinical content doctor ke bina publish ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Safety-critical material requires qualified dental/medical reviewer sign-off; add high-severity block when source/rationale/reviewer missing.

q_and_a.question: Agar AI medical recommendation unsafe de de toh?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Catch via risk policy and evaluation tests, cite approved safety sources, abstain/redirect, log review flag and withhold unsafe output; do not use prompt-only controls as sole defense.

q_and_a.question: Kya case performance ko clinical competence certificate bana sakte hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Simulator is independent educational practice, not clinical licensure, eligibility, professional certification or proof of real-patient competence.

q_and_a.question: Kya each case stage reviewed hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: case intro, red flags, reasoning steps, expected safe decisions, rationale, feedback and versions; per-stage reviewer sign-off and traceability.

q_and_a.question: Kya old incorrect content silently change karna safe hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Version content, audit changes, record affected attempts, notify users if regrading needed. Preserve original attempt context for explainable score revisions.

q_and_a.question: Kya abhi real AI interviewer live hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Current deployed baseline contains self-guided text and opt-in browser voice-to-text; do not call it fully adaptive conversational AI until a secured provider-backed integration is implemented and tested. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff

q_and_a.question: Kya voice input dena compulsory hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Nahi. Optional microphone consent, clear external-browser transcription disclosure, permission rejection fallback to text, and editable transcript before saving.

q_and_a.question: Kya AI genuinely follow-up pooch sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Future target yes, using authenticated server proxy, saved context and safe model configuration. It must never fabricate model capability or silently incur paid usage.

q_and_a.question: Kya AI marks 92/100 deta toh usko reliable samjhein?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Not without calibrated rubric, multiple blinded human-rated anchors, inter-rater agreement and out-of-sample evaluation. Until then show descriptive feedback only, not pseudo-official scores.

q_and_a.question: Clinical viva mein answers ki medical accuracy kaise check hogi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Use reviewed evidence/golden cases, red-flag safety criteria and human expert evaluation of sampled outputs. AI can summarize gaps but cannot certify clinical correctness alone.

q_and_a.question: Kya AI hamare student ka personal data use karega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Use minimal necessary transcript, informed consent and privacy policy; do not send identifiers or clinical patient data. Provider retention and cross-border processing disclosures must be clear.

q_and_a.question: Kya 5, 15 aur 30 min ke options actual timer honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: When enabled, duration goal vs enforced timer must be distinguished. Existing self-guided goal cannot be called an official UPSC interview or guaranteed time-boxed live agent.

q_and_a.question: Kya mixed Hindi-English speech supported rahegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Begin with en-IN where supported, disclose recognition errors, allow manual editing and fallback. Multilingual support should be tested with medical terminology on real devices.

q_and_a.question: AI ka feedback har baar ek jaisa reliable hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Require objective rubric, source references for factual critique, uncertainty, deterministic regression sets and human sampling; document model/version drift and known limits.

q_and_a.question: Kya interview history private aur resumable rahegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes with per-user isolation, explicit Save Draft/Finish, transcript status and recoverable interrupted sessions. Test user A cannot load user B interviews.

q_and_a.question: Kya slow mobile network par app chalegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Progressive loading, retry, offline reading where cached, low-byte assets and clear save status; measure 3G/4G flows and test no silent data loss.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya website ki har button sach me kaam karegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Clickable visual mock is not sufficient: each action needs route, state mutation, backend validation, keyboard behavior and Playwright screenshot/test evidence. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya student ka data app update par delete ho jayega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: It should not. Use schema migrations, backups and forward-compatible client states; test rollout, rollback and account persistence on real data-safe staging fixtures.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya password ya service-role keys browser mein jayengi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Never. Only publishable backend key is client-safe; server secrets belong in protected environment and authorization decisions enforced server-side and by RLS.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya Supabase database Bite se mix ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Never. Existing DentPrep Lovable/Supabase project remains separate from restaurant-os. Verify URLs/IDs in environment and guard against cross-project migrations.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya notification official UPSC announcement jaisa claim karegi?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Only based on verified official update and source URL, with timestamp. If not independently checked, label provisional/unverified and avoid push notification certainty.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya color contrast aur tap targets check honge?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Target WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable, test actual mobile touch size, keyboard/focus visibility, alt text, zoom and reduced motion.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya offline mode se expired medical note show ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Mark offline cached version/date and validity; when online check update/revocation. Safety-critical withdrawn material should not be presented as current without warning.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya bugs aur errors ka evidence milega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Yes: scenario ID, reproduction, device/browser, console/network trace, screenshot, severity, fix PR/commit, retest status, regression guard.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya analytics secretly track sensitive study/interview answers?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Prefer privacy-minimizing product telemetry, explicit notices, no raw transcript logging in analytics, role-restricted access, retention and deletion controls.
q_and_a.code_area: auth.tsx, PWA, deployment scripts; all private tables

q_and_a.question: Kya 50 software scenarios enough hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: They are minimum cross-functional acceptance; add dedicated medical content validation, learning outcome mastery tests, hallucination tests and actual longitudinal student pilots. No 50/50 Pass implies medically accurate teaching.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya har test automated ho sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Unit, integration and simulated browser tests automate much; clinical review, actual microphone, OAuth, Android APK, visual inspection and real learning retention need qualified humans/devices.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya Pass likhna evidence ke bina chalega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Each test gets steps, expected vs actual, environment, log/screenshot, branch/SHA and reviewer. Mark Blocked/Not Run if not executed. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya 100 Q&A ke answers current app me already live hain?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. This Q&A is a quality/implementation contract and gap checklist. Current code, database and tests must be audited before marking each item done.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya medical expert review sign-off Work khud kar sakta hai?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Work can build queue, check evidence and create draft; only appropriately qualified and authorized reviewer can perform accountable clinical approval.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya naya feature directly main par push karna sahi hoga?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Use small PRs with typecheck, security scan, unit/integration tests, browser QA, safe merge and verified production rollout. Keep rollback/incident plan.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya deployment green hone ka matlab student journey green?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. Successful SSR/assets/PWA checks prove technical release only. Real login, saving, voice, mobile device and reviewed content learning must separately pass.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Agar Work limit khatam ho jaye toh kya?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Persist DENTPREP_COMPLETION_LEDGER.md, 50-scenario matrix, PR links, exact SHA, blockers and next safe task in repository. Next session resume from verified state; no redo.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Kya app kisi ko UPSC selection guarantee de?
q_and_a.required_behavior: No. No guarantee of selection, no official equivalence, no claimed readiness probability. Provide transparent educational progress, uncertainty and official source checking.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger

q_and_a.question: Final 100% complete kaun decide karega?
q_and_a.required_behavior: Definition of Done requires every blueprint workflow, content quality review, all critical 50 scenarios with proof, learning validation, real-device acceptance and trustworthy production release. Unmet external gates stay Blocked, never cosmetically 100%.
q_and_a.code_area: CI/release workflows, ops SQL, GitHub ledger
